note: Expected output tokens per call (visible output plus thinking/reasoning, as billed). The forecast uses these instead of a share of the output cap, so raising a cap to prevent truncation does not change the forecast. MEASURED cells come from run cost logs (litreview output-shares RUN); ASSUMED cells have no completed call behind them and must be replaced after the calibration run. The NON-REPRESENTATIVE A07->A09 sample is never used here.
